svg.aria-label: A slot evaluation ends in one of eight outcomes: holds, does not hold, not Boolean, unavailable, undefined, refused, incomplete or a family result. Admission of a handoff fails with one of six refusals: reader, incomplete, selection file, selection, identities or equality, each carrying its owner's value unchanged.
